procedure.method: Fresh independent review with no spawn, resume, fork or peer/producer-record inspection. Read the pinned packet, case, rubric, rules and compact method; read all five listed native-evidence manifests before poster opens, without following their unlisted embedded paths. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are empty, so there were no source opens or protected manifests to read. Byte/hash/PNG-header checks were metadata verification only, not claimed visual opens. Actually opened and inspected the fifteen exact poster assets with tools.view_image(detail=original), emitting each returned image for visual inspection, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. All fifteen were completed before the first copy-reading/transcription, judgment or score. First readings were taken from those displayed pinned views after the complete sequence; usage720 readability and thumbnail hierarchy were assessed from their actual displayed assets. No ambiguity required a revisit. Each native was verified as RGB PNG 1672x941; 16:9 acceptance uses the pinned single-edge height-rounding difference of 0.5 pixel. Usage views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180, with the required aspect and reduction sizes. No helper exit or filename was treated as proof of viewing and no runtime session/tool-event ID is claimed.

Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.

evidence.observation: The window, differently oriented walls, rear doorway and receding floor remain recognizable without reading any letters; changing those forms would change the architectural/light message.

content_form.location: window opening, shadows and title on foreground wall
content_form.observation: The photographed architecture supplies an immediate example of light resting on built surfaces; the house title is anchored to an actual wall, and the joint exhibition/space-story line connects the subject to the event. The room and main title survive reduction; practical details become supporting small text rather than the main silhouette.

typography.location: Korean serif title and right-side sans-serif lines

space.location: blue wall, window jamb and open floor
space.observation: The large quiet upper-left wall balances the light-filled room and lets the low title sit on a substantial foreground plane. Right-side groups occupy separate vertical levels with enough air between them. The upper-left void is generous but has a clear wall/depth function.

emotion_control.location: sunlit open room and lower-right visitor reassurance
emotion_control.observation: Warm light, an open doorway and quiet space communicate an unhurried adult visit. The welcoming phrases reinforce that mood, although the visual itself emphasizes contemplation more than gathering.

ai_slop.observation: The visible details serve the architecture/light idea; there are no unrelated emblems, spurious print fragments or decorative objects. The restrained scene does retain the familiar polished-empty-interior look shared with M2, limiting specificity above a strong professional level.

residuals: The empty polished room establishes architecture/light more directly than the exhibition or communal discussion; those event modes depend on the subtitle.
M1 and M2 share photographic empty-interior imagery, cast foliage shadows and information placed on wall planes, despite different crops and reading structures.
Small practical details are not all comfortably readable at thumbnail320; they are readable at the required usage720.

Literal mandatory client conditions:
Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.
Architecture/light observation and the photo-exhibition plus space-talk event must connect coherently, with an approachable adult community-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720. No identifiable real building/institution promotion.
Explicit whole-template exclusion: passive solid/near-solid/split-color fields dominated by gothic title/date/information blocks with subordinate inset/bottom-strip imagery. Thin texture/gradient/grids or title/all-font-only substitutions do not cure unchanged organization. Evaluate actual whole image/scene/editing/space/type relationships; readable information groups or negative space alone are not violations. No explicit override is requested.

evidence.location: foreground visitors, photo display and seated group
evidence.observation: The large human/gallery scene gives the photo exhibition and shared space conversation concrete nonglyph roles. It is substantial content, not a tiny icon, texture or letter model.

evidence.location: gallery across center and right
evidence.observation: Architecture photographs, attentive viewers, a seated conversation and daylight remain visible at usage size. The scene contributes both event identity and an approachable arrival perspective.

content_form.location: foreground frame, photo wall and seated explanation
content_form.observation: The viewer-facing composition joins observing architectural photographs with a nearby seated conversation in one illuminated communal room. The foreground people place the audience near the activity; the floor title belongs to that entry/viewing space rather than a detached footer panel.

hierarchy.location: lower-center headline, photo wall and upper information
hierarchy.observation: The large lower headline names the event after the eye registers the gallery activity. The upper-left schedule and upper-right participation terms remain accessible, while smaller lower-left reassurance sits outside the main title group.
The title remains recognizable and the standing/seated activities remain distinct, though upper practical text is very small at thumbnail scale.

typography.location: large floor title and upper wall copy
typography.observation: The bold Hangul title has clear word gaps and sound glyph construction. Supporting punctuation and the tracked English subtitle remain intact; all copy stays clear of the foreground silhouettes.

typography.location: small lower-left visitor lines and upper information
typography.observation: The smallest practical/advice lines remain readable on stable pale areas, with complete words and visible punctuation.

space.location: cropped shoulders, foreground floor and exhibition wall
space.observation: The close side figures create a defined frame and guide attention into the gallery. Open floor gives the headline generous width, while the photo wall carries upper information and the seated group balances the right side. The frame is substantial but does not conceal type.

image_material.location: people, framed photographs, benches and foliage
image_material.observation: The painterly illustration combines convincing room depth, repeated architectural photo subjects, understandable seating and softly modeled adult figures. Benches, plants and sunlight belong to the same room treatment; small faces/hands are simplified and not exceptional in local refinement.

emotion_control.location: arrival framing and seated adult conversation
emotion_control.observation: The warm gallery, relaxed seated exchange and people quietly viewing images show participation as ordinary and manageable. The reassurance matches the pictured activity and supports a first-time resident without a loud promotional tone.

ai_slop.location: photo row, plant/bench details and discussion group
ai_slop.observation: Recurring plants and photo subjects have understandable room/exhibition roles, and the people form coherent viewing or conversation groups. No spurious symbols, pseudo-text or watermark appear. Repeated sunlit-room subjects and schematic small human details keep the finish below exceptional specificity.

residuals: The four architectural photograph subjects and gallery/social grouping overlap with M3; distinction comes from eye-level crop, foreground people, floor headline and information placement.
